subject: Invoice anomaly: unexpected session multipliers during Aug 18-20 outage
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluewave.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy on Aug invoices after outage

Neha —

We were reviewing our August invoices and noticed an unusually high number of inference sessions attributed to our account for 8/18–8/20. The line items show session multipliers that don't match our internal usage logs; this caused a 42% increase over our forecasted spend for that period.

Attached: 2028-08-bluewave-invoice-aug.pdf (billing export). Can you confirm whether this was related to the incident last week? We need to understand the root cause and the plan for any corrective credits, since this will impact our end-of-quarter forecast.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Operations
BlueWave AI

--
BlueWave Billing <billing@bluewave.ai>
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluewave.ai>, BlueWave Billing <billing@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Aug invoices after outage

Olivia —

Thanks for flagging this and for the attachment. I looked into our incident tracker (INC-2028-0818) and there was a metering edge-case during the 8/18 rolling deployment that caused some session replays to be counted multiple times for a subset of streaming requests. We're compiling the impact now.

Immediate plan: Rishi is pulling precise counts and Marissa will draft a compensatory credit plan for the affected window. I will follow up by EOD with the preliminary credit amount and a short explanation you can share with your finance team.

Attachments: none in this note.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0291
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Discrepancy on Aug invoices after outage — metering delta breakdown

Team —

Quick summary of my findings so far (raw numbers):
- Affected account set: ~120 customers (BlueWave is in the top decile by tokens during the window).
- Counting duplication: ~1.35x multiplier on streaming session token counts for 8/18 03:00–11:45 UTC and 8/19 01:20–02:10 UTC for specific routing shard (gpu-shard-7).
- Preliminary token delta for BlueWave: 1.2M tokens over the two windows.

I'm attaching the machine-readable export and my working sheet (compensation-calcs.xlsx) for visibility. Marissa, please craft a customer-facing credit calculation and proposed communication. Sean, can you confirm finance sign-off cadence for a one-off adjustment vs. invoice credit?

Attachments: compensation-calcs.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluewave.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Aug invoices after outage — proposed remediation

Olivia —

Thanks for your patience. We completed the impact analysis and propose the following remediation steps for BlueWave AI: 

1) One-time invoice credit equal to the excess token charge calculated from 1.2M tokens at your contracted rate (details in attached calc). Proposed credit: $9,120.
2) Proactive automatic refund applied to the Aug invoice by 2028-08-27 (visible as a negative line item).
3) A short root-cause summary (attached) explaining the metering duplication and the fix applied to prevent recurrence (changes deployed to shard routing + additional QA for streaming rollouts).
4) Offer: 3 months of metering anomaly monitoring (no charge) with weekly digest to your Ops team.

Attached: incident-root-cause-summary.pdf, compensation-calcs.xlsx

If that looks good, we will route the credit through Finance and confirm the adjusted invoice number. If you prefer a different form of compensation (prepaid credit vs. direct refund), let us know and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0142
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluewave.ai>

Date: Fri, 25 Aug 2028 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Aug invoices after outage — proposed remediation

Marissa, Neha —

Thank you for the clear breakdown and for moving quickly. We accept the proposed credit of $9,120 applied to the August invoice and appreciate the incident summary — that will help our audit. Please apply the credit and send the updated invoice/credit memo to billing@bluewave.ai. We also accept the 3-month monitoring offer; please add olivia.chen@bluewave.ai to the weekly digest.

Two quick asks:
- Can you provide a short, non-technical summary we can attach to our internal finance note? (1 paragraph)
- Please confirm when the updated ledger entry will be visible.

Regards,
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Operations
BlueWave AI
